snippet.title: Turning Manor - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Turning Manor launches on PC via Steam November 4th 2026!
Uncover why eerie things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract in a new type of anomaly game. 

Wishlist and follow here to be notified when the Manor opens: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4040700/Turning_Manor_Demo/ 

#horrorgame #anomalygame #indiegame
